description: This script generates Vulkan format mapping code for ANGLE project, based on JSON data. It includes templates for C++ code output, functions for processing format data, and a main function that orchestrates the code generation.

methods.name: is_packed
methods.description: Checks if a format ID indicates a packed format based on '_PACK' substring.

methods.name: verify_vk_map_keys
methods.description: Verifies that Vulkan format keys exist in the ANGLE format mapping.

methods.name: get_vertex_copy_function
methods.description: Determines the vertex copy function based on source/destination formats and Vulkan format.

methods.name: gen_format_case
methods.description: Generates a switch case entry for a specific format, including image and buffer templates.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that loads data, verifies keys, generates code, and writes output file.
